description: Dockerfile build-cache and reproducibility lint — Parses a Dockerfile (continuations, escape directive, heredocs, flags, stages) and reports instruction orderings that defeat the layer cache or make rebuilds drift, for agents writing or reviewing container builds. Cache: COPY of the whole context before a dependency or package install, apt-get update in its own RUN, per-build ARG/ENV values (build date, git sha) declared before later RUN steps. R

basePin.description: tag (default): flag only missing or :latest tags. digest: flag every base image not pinned by @sha256.

dockerfile.description: Dockerfile text, at most 5000 lines and 128 stages.

include.description: Rule categories that decide the status. Default cache and reproducibility.

name: dockerfile-cache-lint
